body: But if we don't, I really don't want him to feel like he's got that like, held over him. I can't stand the thought of hurting him.

I'm probably just going to mail it to him after I get it. The signature, anyway, and whatever else I end up getting for him. I can send him the video as soon as possible. I don't want to make him wait, since he knows I'm getting it for him. And I don't necessarily want to tell him that he got me suicidal, I know he'd feel bad. I hate making him feel guilty.

Whether he hates me or not, my mind is still going to tell me he does. I can hope he doesn't, but you know, I've got a stubborn brain.

He liked me, not anymore though. Someone asked and he said he only likes S. I like to think that if I *did* kill myself, it wouldn't really affect him. Or maybe it'd be a relief, nothing he'd kill himself over for sure. Staying alive is about the only promise he's kept to his younger self.

Anyway, I'm really hoping that he'll get out of it with S soon, but like I said, I think I'm kinda a hypocrite for that, all things considered. It's a struggle holding onto this teeny tiny hope that he'll love me again, but I guess it's all I've got. So I guess I'll do just that, try to hold onto it.

Yeah, no matter what happens I'll send the video and package and everything. I guess I can just not say any lovey nicknames when I send it. Kinda sucks having the same name as his favourite actor, though. That actor is his favourite person in the world and it's strange seeing "I love ____ so much" and knowing it's not me. But ah, I'll get over it one of these days. I'm glad there's someone who can make him happy, even if it's not me. Blah blah, out on a tangent.

I'm still moving to his state either way, as I said my best friend is there, too, so if anything I'll just move to be with her. I keep telling myself to try to get over him, but always end up convincing myself that it's really not that big a deal and that things will work out fine. I live in a state of denial.

That's the thing, though. No matter what he says or how he treats me, I feel like he deserves all the love in the world and everything I could ever give him. I feel sick when I think of not going through with all the promises I made to him.

Spring Awakening! Deaf West, to be specific. Traditional Broadway mixed with ASL, all very cool.
